display.name: Decode 诊断
display.description: 统一核心图表；来源特有指标列于专属诊断。单位见标题，统计差异见图表提示。

display.name: Decode KV 池占用（%）
display.description:
指标含义
源调度器 token_usage，反映 KV Token 池占用，不是整卡显存占用。

XPU 环境；实例、节点或 rank 分线展示，复制数据不直接相加。

spec.query: (sglang:token_usage{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:token_usage{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:token_usage{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5))))) * 100

display.name: Decode 运行与排队请求（请求）
display.description:
指标含义
调度器当前运行与排队请求，按原始 rank 分线，未对复制 rank 求总和。

XPU 环境；实例、节点或 rank 分线展示，复制数据不直接相加。

spec.query: (sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))))

(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))))
